email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoBasalin patient with severe hypoglycemia and became unresponsive at home
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 40-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their fourth dose of DemoBasalin (dose: 1 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-05-17.
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe hypoglycemia and became unresponsive at home.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
M. Tanaka (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter747@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
